description.en: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Returns a cited read on decisions and tradeoffs. Use how for runtime behavior.
description.zh: 用于「X 为什么是这样运作的」「我们当初为什么选了 Y」、设计理由、回归问题、事后复盘，或者有数据撑着的阈值。它会交回一份带出处的解读，讲清当初的决定和取舍。代码运行时怎么表现，用 how。

blocks.en: Answer from the record, not the code: read the commits and PR discussions that introduced the target and each later change, and other sources if the trail is thin. Cite what the authors wrote, mark your own inferences as inferences, and say what the record does not answer.
blocks.zh: 从记录里找答案，不从代码里找：读引入这个对象的提交和 PR 讨论，以及之后每一次改动的；如果线索很少，再查别的来源。引用作者写下的原话，把你自己的推断标明是推断，并说出记录里回答不了的部分。

lessons.quote: Answer from the record, not the code: read the commits and PR discussions that introduced the target and each later change, and other sources if the trail is thin.
lessons.quoteZh: 从记录里找答案，不从代码里找：读引入这个对象的提交和 PR 讨论，以及之后每一次改动的；如果线索很少，再查别的来源。

zh.title: 指明答案该从哪儿找
zh.does: 它去翻当初的提交和 PR 讨论，而不是盯着代码编一个听着合理的理由。
zh.why: 代码只说明「是什么」，说不出「为什么」；点名该读哪份记录、读到哪一次改动，AI 就没法拿猜测交差。
zh.try: 问原因时指明出处：「去看引入这个设置的那次提交和讨论，再看之后每次改动，别只看现在的代码。」

en.title: Name where the answer lives
en.does: It reads the original commits and PR discussions instead of inventing a plausible reason from the code.
en.why: Code shows what, not why; naming which record to read, through every later change, leaves no room to hand in a guess.
en.try: When you ask why, point to the source: "Read the commit and discussion that added this setting, and each change since, not just today's code."

lessons.quote: Cite what the authors wrote, mark your own inferences as inferences, and say what the record does not answer.
lessons.quoteZh: 引用作者写下的原话，把你自己的推断标明是推断，并说出记录里回答不了的部分。

zh.title: 要求分开说事实和猜测
zh.does: 答案里作者原话、它自己的推断、查不到的部分分开写，你知道哪句能直接信。
zh.why: 「为什么」很容易被编圆；逼它给推断贴上标签、把空白说出来，猜测就藏不进事实里。
zh.try: 问原因时加一句：「有出处的引原话，自己推测的标上『推测』，查不到的直接说查不到。」

en.title: Ask for facts and guesses apart
en.does: Quotes from the authors, its own inferences and the open gaps come apart, so you know which lines to trust outright.
en.why: A "why" story is easy to smooth over; labeling inferences and naming the gaps keeps guesses out of the facts.
en.try: When you ask why, add: "Quote what has a source, mark your own guesses 'guess', and say plainly what you couldn't find."

lessons.quoteZh: 代码运行时怎么表现，用 how。

zh.title: 说明里写清不归它管的事
zh.does: 问的是代码运行时怎么表现，它会让给 `how`，不会拿翻历史记录来回答。
zh.why: 只写「什么时候用」，相邻的两个工具容易抢活；再加一句「这类问题找谁」，边界就清楚了。
zh.try: 给 AI 分工时写明边界：「你只管文案；排版的问题交给设计那边，别自己改。」

en.title: Say what isn't its job
en.does: Questions about runtime behavior go to `how`, instead of being answered from history.
en.why: "When to use" alone lets neighboring tools step on each other; adding who handles the rest draws the line.
en.try: When you split up work, mark the edge: "You handle the copy; layout questions go to design, don't change it yourself."

compare.without: 看着代码猜一个当初这样写的理由
compare.with: 读引入它和之后每次改动的提交与 PR 讨论，线索少再查别的来源

compare.without: 把自己猜出来的理由当成事实说
compare.with: 引用作者原话，自己的推断标明是推断

compare.without: 找不到答案也硬凑一个说法
compare.with: 说清记录里回答不了的部分

zh.intro: 它从提交和 PR 讨论这些记录里找代码为什么长成这样，线索少时再查别的来源；引用作者原话，推断标成推断，说出记录答不了的部分。

compare.without: Guesses a reason from the code itself.
compare.with: Reads the commits and PR discussions behind it and each later change, then other sources if the trail is thin.

compare.without: States a guessed reason as if it were fact.
compare.with: Quotes what the authors wrote and marks its own inferences as inferences.

compare.without: Pieces together an answer even when the record has none.
compare.with: Says what the record does not answer.

en.intro: It answers why from the record, not the code: the commits and PR discussions, then other sources if the trail is thin. It cites the authors, marks inferences, and names what the record leaves open.
